posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Katrina and Vicky Kaushal introduced baby Vihaan to Mumbai paparazzi for the first time at the airport, with one request — no photos of the little one.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Diljit shared exciting BTS photos from 'Sardaar Ji 3' with Neeru Bajwa and announced the teaser is coming soon ahead of its June 27 release. His Imtiaz Ali film also drops June 12.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Alia's YRF spy thriller 'Alpha' preponed to July 3 for a clear two-week window. She was also among the stars Karan Johar unfollowed during his dramatic Instagram 'digital detox.'

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Priyanka confirms six months of shoot pending for SS Rajamouli's epic 'Varanasi' with Mahesh Babu. Notably, she was the one star KJo kept following during his mass Instagram unfollow spree.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: SRK shot a new Google Gemini ad at Mehboob Studios as his ₹350 crore action thriller 'King' with Suhana Khan, Deepika, and Abhishek Bachchan locks Christmas 2026 release.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Bebo enters her 'padel era' and is in advanced talks to reunite with Salman Khan for Raj & DK's superhero film — their first collaboration since Bajrangi Bhaijaan.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Shraddha's pajama dance video to Michael Jackson's 'Bad' went viral, with her cheeky caption sparking rumours about beau Rahul Mody. She also shut down a troll with a savage reply.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Deepika announced her second pregnancy with Ranveer Singh and will use a body double for action in Allu Arjun's film, while still shooting combat scenes for SRK's 'King.'

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Ranveer faces an FWICE non-cooperation directive after exiting Don 3 weeks before shoot, with ₹45 crore losses alleged. Spotted in Budapest hanging with Arsenal's Declan Rice.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Aishwarya stunned at Cannes 2026 with swan-inspired couture and Amit Aggarwal's cosmic 'Luminara' creation. Daughter Aaradhya joined her on the red carpet in a blush pink moment.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Rashmika represented India at the Global Anime Awards in Tokyo alongside Black Panther's Winston Duke, and is now promoting 'Cocktail 2' with Shahid and Kriti ahead of its June 19 release.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Samantha turned heads in a hand-painted Kalamkari warrior saree at the 'Maa Inti Bangaaram' trailer launch — a Telugu film she's also producing with husband Raj Nidimoru.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Allu Arjun is reportedly in talks with Lokesh Kanagaraj for a massive project after wrapping Atlee's ₹600 crore sci-fi spectacle 'Raka' co-starring Deepika, Mrunal, and Janhvi.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Ram Charan's ₹350 crore sports drama 'Peddi' releases June 4. He recalled telling PM Modi the film is about 'an evolved India and empowering our villages.'

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Jr NTR's first glimpse as 'Luger' in Prashanth Neel's 'Dragon' reveals his darkest avatar yet. He also paid tribute to grandfather NT Rama Rao on his 103rd birth anniversary.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Janhvi co-stars with Ram Charan in the highly anticipated 'Peddi' releasing June 4 and is part of Allu Arjun's mega-budget sci-fi film with Atlee and Deepika Padukone.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Ananya was among the B-town stars caught in Karan Johar's dramatic Instagram 'digital detox' mass unfollow. She continues to be a favourite at industry events and fashion outings.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Kiara stole the spotlight at the Nita Ambani Cultural Centre anniversary in a stunning pink saree. She's set to return to the big screen in 'War 2' alongside Hrithik and Jr NTR.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Hrithik's 'Krrish 4' is stuck in limbo over VFX disagreements, while 'War 2' with Jr NTR receives a staggering ₹100 crore offer for Telugu states distribution rights alone.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Varun's David Dhawan-directed rom-com 'Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai' locks June 5 release after Yash's 'Toxic' postponement. He thanked Yash for clearing the date.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Shreya Ghoshal's 'The Unstoppable Tour' heads to Australia in June and a massive US arena tour in September, with 16+ upcoming shows spanning Auckland to Oakland.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: AR Rahman performed a grand live concert in Bhopal for Ram Charan's 'Peddi' song launch. His track 'Chikiri Chikiri' from the film has crossed 200 million YouTube views.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Now Tamil Nadu's Chief Minister, Vijay's final film 'Jana Nayagan' still awaits CBFC certification after being leaked online. Madras HC denied bail to six accused in the leak case.
